responses.answer: I'm **Abhiram Varma Nandimandalam**, Data Scientist at the University of Arizona in the Laboratory for Social Connectedness & Health (LSCH). My profile sits at **Data Science × Bioinformatics × Psychology × Health**. I'm also an **AI enthusiast** focused on **reproducible AI workflows**, LLM pipelines, and trustworthy research tooling.

I care about **reproducible AI workflows**, documented LLM/RAG pipelines, shareable research tooling, and analytical systems others can rerun and trust. That pairs with my LSCH work building AI-driven methods for behavioral and health research.

I don't position my work under a 'Biology' headline. My framing is **Data Science, Bioinformatics, Psychology, and Health**, including social connectedness, behavior, genomics, and epigenetics as research interests.

I'm a Scientific Analyst / Data Scientist in **LSCH** (Laboratory for Social Connectedness & Health) under Prof. David A. Sbarra, building AI methods and analytical infrastructure for behavioral and health research. Social connectedness themes are an important interdisciplinary interest.

**Genomics, epigenetics, and DNA methylation** appear on this site as **areas of interest**, alongside bioinformatics, not as fabricated job titles. My documented work emphasizes data science, ML/NLP, and health/behavioral research infrastructure.

Find my work on **Google Scholar** (~12 citations), **ORCID**, **ResearchGate**, and badges on **Credly**. Publications include LLM-HyPZ and a multi-class skin disease classification paper, see the Publications section.
Projects include Rural Health Kiosk (Co-Lab Award 2026), Lumen, HealthMate, ReviewIQ, DataLoom, and more, all listed under Work with original descriptions and links.
Current: Scientific Analyst, Data Science @ UA Psychology / LSCH. Prior: Housing GA, Campus Health analyst, MITHRA Lab GRA (ICDM 2025), NIT Puducherry ML researcher.
